counts: Retain raw native prompt_n, predicted_n, cache_n, draft_n and draft_n_accepted.
prefill: sum prompt_n / (sum prompt_ms / 1000), within a round; cache_n separate.
decode: sum predicted_n / (sum predicted_ms / 1000), within a round. Both Gufo and Halogen native conventions; no llama-specific first-token subtraction.
missing: unknown, never wall-clock inference or zero
preflight: Actual streamed responses must supply native prompt_n,prompt_ms,predicted_n,predicted_ms,cache_n before scoring.
speed_probes: 512 generated tokens exactly, 3 rounds for each input length; quality not scored.
cache: Cold first calls request cache_prompt=false, subsequent tool/history calls true; actual cache counters and any engine policy are preserved.
